source: User-supplied Trailaris Market Execution Engine R5.5 handover, sections 1-33 as visible on 2026-08-16; section 33 text is truncated after 'Every trade instructio'.

sections.name: Market Execution Engine system position
sections.action: Preserve; strategies remain components inside the market-execution cycle.

sections.name: Full-universe hard lock
sections.action: Preserve exact 34/15/510 gates for every material replay.

sections.name: Global acquisition logic
sections.gap: Authentic 34-route paths exist, but there is no single canonical per-route acquisition-source registry binding source, normalization contract, venue/broker contract, session and execution metadata for every market class.
sections.action: Build canonical Acquisition Route Registry and source-health/failover contract before production certification.

sections.name: Broker Authorization Gate
sections.gap: Architecture and 238 broker-route cells exist, but confirmed_available_cells=0 and certified_cells=0 pending exact target-server evidence.
sections.action: Require broker legal entity + server + account type + symbol contract + strategy eligibility certification before production.

sections.name: Research to thesis to execution
sections.gap: Causal market-state/event/crypto intelligence exists, but broad macro/fundamental, scheduled catalyst, positioning and non-crypto flow evidence are not yet a complete authoritative research layer across all relevant asset classes.
sections.action: Expand released-at-time intelligence ingestion without future-data leakage.

sections.name: Factor-level market intelligence
sections.gap: Aggregate factor vectors/deduplication exist; explicit dominant-factor identification -> strongest-expression ranking -> correlation deduplication is not yet a first-class auditable decision object.
sections.action: Promote factor thesis and expression ranking to explicit ledger fields and counterfactual attribution.

sections.name: Opportunity discovery and ranking
sections.gap: Cross-market best-expression comparison and missed-superior-opportunity attribution should be strengthened.
sections.action: Tie opportunity ranking to the R5.5 opportunity-capture gate.

sections.name: Strategy role
sections.action: Preserve all 15 families; no permanent historical entitlement.

sections.name: Campaign-level execution
sections.gap: Research engine supports parent/add-on/campaign management, but production campaign ownership, broker-order mapping and reconnect reconciliation are not yet independently durable.
sections.action: Implement durable campaign ledger in production runtime.

sections.name: Capital recycling
sections.action: Continue winner-priority and opportunity-capture testing without indiscriminate churn.

sections.name: Daily opportunity-capture hard lock
sections.gap: Opportunity-capture evidence exists historically but is not yet an explicit mandatory R5.5 pre-forward promotion gate for every challenger.
sections.action: Add capture-ratio, missed-opportunity, entry/exit efficiency, MFE giveback, add-on contribution and miss-reason non-regression to R5.5 promotion evidence.

sections.name: Evidence-state and promotion discipline
sections.action: Preserve failed evidence; remove only obsolete executable machinery, not historical results.

sections.name: R5.3 forensic foundation
sections.action: Historical control/evidence only.

sections.name: Forensic alpha attribution
sections.gap: Ensure every future candidate reconciles the same attribution dimensions to final compounded equity.
sections.action: Make candidate attribution reconciliation mandatory before freeze.

sections.name: Concentration and counterfactual analysis
sections.gap: Management counterfactuals exist, but an automated full R5.5 top-1/top-3/top-5/top-10 contributor-removal portfolio recomputation gate is not yet canonical.
sections.action: Build contributor concentration/counterfactual gate before candidate freeze.

sections.name: Component ablation
sections.gap: Many component experiments exist, but no canonical full architecture ablation matrix covering research/thesis, ranking, strategy selection, regime, add-ons, partials, protection, runners, recycling, sizing, compounding and campaign management.
sections.action: Run full-universe architecture ablation and classify KEEP/STRENGTHEN/REPAIR/RETEST/REMOVE/RESEARCH_FURTHER.

sections.name: Compounding decomposition
sections.gap: No canonical decomposition was found for normal compounding vs constant starting-equity sizing vs constant nominal risk vs constant valid exposure.
sections.action: Implement full-universe compounding decomposition before final candidate freeze.

sections.name: Loss forensics
sections.action: Continue causal class-specific repair; never force a universal loss filter.

sections.name: R5.4 frozen control
sections.action: Immutable.

sections.name: R5.5 flat-conversion objective
sections.action: Continue Pareto/winner-aware repair; right-tail preservation mandatory.

sections.name: R5.5 loss classes
sections.action: Preserve reconciled 107/68/54 cohorts as forensic targets, not future predictors.

sections.name: R5.5 management-repair research
sections.action: Continue only if full replay improves frontier.

sections.name: Lane 1B-2 frozen result
sections.action: Preserve as frozen completed evidence and incumbent return benchmark; not promotable.

sections.name: Current R5.5 causal direction
sections.action: Current scope now extends beyond Lane2 into management Pareto, strategy rebuild, market-state and winner amplification.

sections.name: Execution authenticity
sections.gap: Execution degradation is a promotion requirement but target-server route/account certification is not complete.
sections.action: Complete exact route-specific spreads, commissions, funding, slippage, fills, rejects, latency, lot/margin/session/order-rule degradation after candidate freeze and before production.

sections.name: Temporal falsification
sections.gap: Causal timestamp discipline exists, but no dedicated adversarial suite was found for same-bar contamination, timestamp perturbation, delayed publication, synchronization and session-boundary falsification.
sections.action: Build dedicated temporal falsification suite and make pass mandatory.

sections.name: Parameter robustness
sections.gap: No canonical profitable-basin/sensitivity gate was found that perturbs every promoted parameter around the selected point and rejects knife-edge optima.
sections.action: Build full-universe parameter-neighborhood robustness gate before candidate freeze.

sections.name: Fail-safe and operational resilience layer
sections.gap: Research engine has internal risk/margin/factor/weekly breakers, but not an independent production fail-safe process.
sections.action: Build independently deployable safety runtime before live production activation.

sections.name: Fail-closed principle
sections.gap: Research/promotion gates fail closed; live runtime account/position/data/contract/campaign/server reconciliation fail-closed enforcement is not yet implemented.
sections.action: Implement production state-reconciliation gate: uncertain state => no new risk.

sections.name: Independent Risk Guardian
sections.gap: No independently running process currently calculates broker positions/exposure/margin/drawdown/order anomalies and overrides the Market Execution Engine.
sections.action: Build separate Risk Guardian service with independent broker truth and kill authority before production.

sections.name: Multi-level circuit breakers
sections.gap: No independent five-level WARNING/RESTRICTED/SAFE/EMERGENCY_STOP/FULL_ISOLATION state machine is implemented.
sections.action: Implement in Risk Guardian/production runtime, not inside alpha logic.

sections.name: Portfolio loss circuit breakers
sections.gap: Research engine includes some weekly/config/asset/risk/factor/margin breakers, but independent intraday loss, loss velocity, correlation convergence, cost spike and spread-explosion production breakers are incomplete.
sections.action: Implement independent production thresholds with strategy-conviction override authority.

sections.name: Runaway order protection
sections.gap: Visible handover requires duplicate/retry/position-growth/lot-decimal/node/reconnect protection; source text is truncated after 'Every trade instructio', so the remainder has not yet been audited.
sections.action: Implement idempotent instruction IDs, deduplication, bounded retry, lot sanity, node lease/leader ownership, stale-command expiry and reconnect replay protection in production runtime; ingest remainder of section when supplied.

governance: A PARTIAL or NOT_IMPLEMENTED item may not be represented as production-ready. Research hardening that can affect candidate truth is done before candidate freeze. Live broker/runtime safety is implemented and certified before production activation and is not allowed to distort historical alpha selection.
